identities.name: Assets = Liabilities + Equity
identities.description: The fundamental accounting equation, with mezzanine (temporary) equity as its third term: redeemable noncontrolling interests and redeemable preferred stock are presented between liabilities and equity, so a filing passes when Assets = Liabilities + Equity incl. NCI OR Assets = Liabilities + Equity incl. NCI + TemporaryEquity (Federal Realty FY2018 closes to the dollar only with its $136.2M redeemable NCI; other filers already carry the amount inside liabilities or equity, hence either base). A filing that fails both is almost certainly a parsing error (sign flip, missing concept, or wrong taxonomy mapping). Tolerance 0.5% absorbs minority-interest treatment quirks. The third term is also read off the raw redemption-value / fair-value / component tags (RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquity*, TemporaryEquity*) when the filer presents the mezzanine line at a measure the catalog does not map to TemporaryEquity; each candidate or their sum may close the equation.

identities.name: CurrentAssets + NoncurrentAssets = TotalAssets
identities.description: Detects mis-classified subtotal — when one of the two children was tagged with the wrong us-gaap element. Catches the most common Goodwill / Intangibles bucketing mistake.

identities.name: CurrentLiabilities + NoncurrentLiabilities = TotalLiabilities
identities.description: Same logic as bs_02 on the liabilities side.

identities.name: TotalLiabilitiesAndEquity = TotalAssets
identities.description: When the filer reports the explicit "Total liabilities and equity" line item, it must equal "Total assets". A redundant restatement of bs_01 — but the redundancy is exactly what makes it useful: if bs_01 passes but bs_04 fails, the equity subtotal is wrong.

identities.name: CommonSharesOutstanding = CommonSharesIssued - TreasuryShares
identities.description: Share-count plumbing. A break here corrupts every per-share ratio in the SDK; we flag aggressively.

identities.name: StockholdersEquity + MinorityInterest = StockholdersEquityIncludingNCI
identities.description: Bridges parent-only equity to the consolidated total used across the institutional grid. MinorityInterest is 0 for single-entity filers (treated as 0). A break means the parent/total equity concepts are crossed or NCI is double-counted.

identities.name: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet = PPEGross - AccumulatedDepreciation
identities.description: Net PP&E ties to gross less accumulated depreciation (stored positive; checked sign-robust via ABS). Skipped when a filer reports only the net line on the face and discloses gross/accum in a footnote we have not captured.

identities.name: IntangibleAssetsNet = IntangibleAssetsGross - AccumulatedAmortization
identities.description: Finite-lived intangibles net = gross less accumulated amortization. WARN because indefinite-lived intangibles (no amortization) and the goodwill/other-intangible split add legitimate slack.

identities.name: StockholdersEquity = CommonStock + APIC + RetainedEarnings + AOCI - TreasuryStock + PreferredStock
identities.description: Parent equity decomposes into its components. WARN (per spec BS_030): rare contra-equity lines (ESOP shares, unearned compensation, receivable-from-shareholders) act as an "other equity" plug, so ~12% of filers carry a small residual. Treasury stored positive, subtracted via ABS.

identities.name: Revenue - CostOfRevenue = GrossProfit
identities.description: Basic gross-profit definition. Tolerance 1% absorbs companies that bundle small COGS items into SG&A.

identities.name: GrossProfit - OperatingExpenses = OperatingIncome
identities.description: Operating bridge. Looser tolerance (2%) because OpEx classification (esp. SBC, R&D) varies across filers.

identities.name: OperatingIncome + OtherIncome - InterestExpense = PretaxIncome
identities.description: Non-operating bridge. Warning severity — banks, insurance, REITs reorder this section; the identity often fails for legit reasons. Use as a soft signal.

identities.name: PretaxIncome - IncomeTaxExpense = IncomeContinuingOps
identities.description: Tax bridge. A break here is almost always a sign flip on IncomeTaxExpense (we expect positive expense, but some filers report negative for benefit). Scope-aware: PretaxIncome - IncomeTaxExpense is consolidated, IncomeContinuingOps is the parent share, so the bridge also holds when the filer tags the consolidated figure (IncomeContinuingOpsIncludingNCI) and that one foots. Equity-method income is presented after tax, so the bridge also holds with EquityMethodIncome added back, and against NetIncomeIncludingNCI (ProfitLoss) less discontinued operations for filers that tag no consolidated continuing-ops line.

identities.name: NetIncome - NetIncomeNCI - DiscontinuedOpsIncome adjustments = NetIncomeToCommon
identities.description: Strips minority interest to get the per-share denominator. We dont add DiscontinuedOpsIncome here because filers vary on whether NetIncome already includes it.

identities.name: EffectiveTaxRate = IncomeTaxExpense / PretaxIncome (when PretaxIncome > 0)
identities.description: Rate plausibility. We allow 100bp absolute slack because filers compute the rate with different bases (federal-only vs federal+state+foreign).

identities.name: Revenue - CostOfRevenue - OperatingExpenses - InterestExpense - IncomeTaxExpense + OtherIncome = IncomeContinuingOps
identities.description: End-to-end income-statement walk: the founder's "Revenue minus all expenses = NetIncome" guard-rail. Catches what the decomposed bridges (is_01..is_04) miss — when a filer omits the intermediate subtotals (GrossProfit / OperatingIncome / PretaxIncome) those identities NULL-skip, but this one still proves the line items reconcile to continuing-ops income. Warning severity + 2% tolerance because it crosses the noisy non-operating section (cf. is_03); a strong #data-bugs signal, deliberately not an export blocker so reordered bank/insurer statements do not gate the publish.

identities.name: IncomeContinuingOps + DiscontinuedOpsIncome = NetIncome
identities.citation: FASB ASC 205-20 (Discontinued Operations); SEC Reg S-X §210.5-03
identities.description: Completes the income walk to the reported bottom line: continuing-ops income plus discontinued-ops income equals NetIncome. DiscontinuedOpsIncome is absent for most filers (treated as 0). Pairs with is_07 to give a Revenue->NetIncome end-to-end chain.

identities.name: TotalRevenue - TotalCostsAndExpenses = OperatingIncome
identities.description: A clean second path to OperatingIncome for filers that report a single TotalCostsAndExpenses line, sidestepping the CostOfRevenue/OperatingExpenses split ambiguity that makes is_02 noisy. Where both is_02 and is_09 are computable they cross-check each other.

identities.name: ComprehensiveIncome = NetIncome + OtherComprehensiveIncome
identities.description: Comprehensive income = net income plus other comprehensive income (FX translation, AFS debt securities, pension/OPEB remeasurements, hedge effects), all three terms PARENT-scope. Measured break rate 4.8%. Its consolidated twin is is_11.

identities.name: ComprehensiveIncomeIncludingNCI = NetIncomeIncludingNCI + OtherComprehensiveIncomeIncludingNCI
identities.description: Consolidated comprehensive income = consolidated net income (incl. NCI) plus consolidated OCI. Measured break rate 2.6%. IFRS filers report only this scope, under the bare ifrs-full tags.

identities.name: |NetIncomeToCommon - EPSBasic × WAS_basic| / |NetIncomeToCommon| <= 0.5%
identities.description: EPS sanity. A break here means either WAS was tagged in thousands while EPS is in dollars-per-share (the most common XBRL-decimals mistake) or NetIncomeToCommon is wrong. Catches both.

identities.name: EPSDiluted <= EPSBasic (anti-dilution)
identities.description: Diluted EPS can never exceed basic — the rule is a mathematical consequence of the anti-dilution test. Tolerance 0.001 absorbs sub-cent rounding.

identities.name: WeightedAvgSharesDiluted >= WeightedAvgSharesBasic
identities.description: Diluted share count includes everything basic includes plus dilutive options/RSUs. Strictly greater-or-equal; no tolerance needed.

identities.name: NetChangeInCash = CFO + CFI + CFF + FXEffect
identities.description: The single most diagnostic identity on the entire cash flow statement. If this fails, one of the three buckets is mis-summed or the FX line is missing.

identities.name: CAPEX is stored as a positive magnitude (use of cash)
identities.description: CAPEX is stored as a positive magnitude; a negative raw fact is the anomaly. The pipeline stores this as a POSITIVE MAGNITUDE (measured 2026-08-27: 98.9% of CAPEX, 99.4% of Dividends and 99.5% of ShareBuyback rows are positive), so the previous lte_zero form fired on essentially the whole population -- 1,078,537 of 3,276,847 logged violations, 33% of the table -- and uniformly downweighted every filing, which carries no information. Inverted to flag the genuine anomaly: a NEGATIVE value means the filer's sign leaked through un-normalised or the line is a reversal.

identities.name: Dividends are stored as a positive magnitude (cash distribution)
identities.description: Same sign-convention check for dividends paid, on the house positive-magnitude convention.

identities.name: ShareBuyback is stored as a positive magnitude (cash distribution)
identities.description: Same sign-convention check for share repurchases, on the house positive-magnitude convention.

identities.name: OperatingCashFlow has the same sign as NetIncome for healthy firms
identities.citation: Penman §10.5 (the "earnings quality" signal); Dechow-Sloan accruals literature
identities.description: Soft (info) signal. Not a violation — CFO can legitimately diverge from NI during working-capital swings — but systematic divergence across many years flags earnings management.

identities.name: CashAndEquivalents[t] = CashAndEquivalents[t-1] + NetChangeInCash[t]
identities.description: Cross-period cash continuity (reconciles at 0.0% median): the cash balance moves by exactly the cash-flow-statement net change. A break is the strongest signal of mixed originally-filed vs restated data — Valuein PIT discipline. Adjacency-guarded (350-380 days) to skip missing-year gaps; WARN + 2% absorbs the restricted-cash / ASU 2016-18 boundary.

identities.name: RE_t = RE_{t-1} + NetIncome_t - Dividends_t
identities.description: Retained-earnings roll-forward. Tolerance 2% — buybacks at cost and stock-comp adjustments enter here in modern GAAP and produce a small bridge gap. A systematic break (>5% of filings) signals corruption.

identities.name: AOCI_t - AOCI_{t-1} = OtherComprehensiveIncome_t
identities.description: OCI linkage. The clean-surplus relation in its purest form. Tolerance absorbs reclassification adjustments.

identities.name: period_end <= accepted_at (PIT contract — observational facts only)
identities.citation: WRDS Compustat PIT; FactSet Fundamentals Methodology v3.4
identities.description: Surfaces facts whose period_end exceeds accepted_at. WARNING (not error) because forward-dated XBRL disclosures are legitimate: 12-month hedge reclassifications, full-year actuarial assumptions disclosed in early Q1 10-Ks, cover-page shares-outstanding dates that lag accepted_at by days, and 8-K item exhibits about future fee schedules / contract starts. The PIT invariant is enforced at QUERY time (WHERE accepted_at <= :as_of_date) by every consumer (SDK / MCP / Bulk Data API), which handles forward-dated facts correctly: at any as_of we see only what was knowable then. This row exists so analysts can still surface the count via qa_violation; the chk_fact_pit_invariant CHECK constraint was removed for the same reason.

identities.name: FY period_span ≈ 365d; Q period_span ≈ 91d
identities.description: Detects filers reporting a partial period under a full-period label (transition periods after fiscal-year changes are the most common cause).

identities.name: fiscal_period in (Q1,Q2,Q3,Q4,FY,TTM)
identities.description: Sanity check on the fiscal-period label. Anything else means the XBRL period-of-report normaliser produced an unknown bucket.

identities.name: fact.accepted_at::date <> fact.period_end (acceptance must lag the period it reports)
identities.citation: SEC EDGAR acceptance-lag convention; WRDS Compustat PIT
identities.description: Surfaces facts whose SEC acceptanceDateTime falls on the very day of the reported period_end. A genuine 10-K/10-Q is accepted weeks-to-months after the period it reports, so accepted_at == period_end is a near-certain stamping error (e.g. accepted_at copied from period_end during a malformed ingest). Non-blocking warning — the chk_fact_pit_invariant CHECK was dropped, so this is the surfaced replacement.

identities.name: fact.accepted_at <= filing.accepted_at (a fact cannot be knowable after its own parent filing)
identities.citation: PIT lineage invariant — fact.accepted_at mirrors filing.accepted_at
identities.description: Every fact inherits its parent filing's SEC acceptanceDateTime, so fact.accepted_at must never exceed filing.accepted_at. A fact stamped LATER than the filing that disclosed it is impossible and signals corrupt accepted_at propagation in the aggregator. Non-blocking warning surfaced via qa_violation; defense-in-depth for the dropped chk_fact_pit_invariant CHECK.

identities.name: TotalAssets > 0
identities.description: No firm has zero or negative total assets at the consolidated level. A break = sign flip on the largest balance-sheet item.

identities.name: TotalRevenue >= 0 (rare contra-revenue allowed)
identities.citation: XBRL US-GAAP Revenues; SEC Reg S-X §210.5-03
identities.description: Negative revenue happens (returns reserves, sales adjustments) but is rare; we warn instead of erroring so we can audit cases.

identities.name: CashAndEquivalents >= 0
identities.description: Cash is by definition non-negative on the balance sheet.

identities.name: CommonSharesOutstanding > 0
identities.citation: FASB ASC 505-10; SEC Form 10-K cover-page conventions
identities.description: No filer has zero shares outstanding. Break = wrong tag (using authorized vs outstanding) or unit confusion.

identities.name: WeightedAvgSharesBasic > 0
identities.description: Basic share count denominator for EPS — cannot be zero.

identities.name: TotalDebt >= 0
identities.description: Debt sign convention; a negative reading means the filer netted debt against an asset (wrong tag).

identities.name: Inventory >= 0
identities.description: Inventory balance is non-negative — negative would imply over-shipped consigned stock, which is a presentation artifact, not a balance-sheet value.

identities.name: GrossProfit <= TotalRevenue (allows negative GP)
identities.description: You cannot earn more gross profit than you booked revenue. Catches the "GrossProfit was misaligned to Revenue row" parser bug.

identities.name: CostOfRevenue >= 0
identities.description: Cost of revenue is non-negative. A negative reading is a sign flip or a contra-account mis-tagged as COGS.

identities.name: DepreciationAndAmortization >= 0
identities.description: D&A is an expense / non-cash add-back; the underlying amount is non-negative. WARN (not ERROR) because rare reclassification lines can carry a negative in some filer presentations.
